title: GEMglLineStipple

messages.description: multiplier for each bit in the line stipple pattern
16-bit pattern of which fragments of a line are drawn

arguments.description: multiplier for each bit in the line stipple pattern
16-bit pattern of which fragments of a line are drawn

body: [GEMglLineStipple] calls glLineStipple() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glLineStipple in the OpenGL reference.
